bpmn:process.name: Where the record is kept
bpmn:process.bpmn:documentation: Where the record of a run is kept. The studyflow document holds the plan and its record: a trail of entries on its root and one record per element. The modeler appends to the trail and voids records; the local runtime appends to the trail, stamps each element's record, and commits every checkpoint into the run repository, whose commits restate the same attributes. There is no sidecar record file. Drawn for docs/developers.qmd.

bpmn:dataObjectReference.name: Trail, on the study's root: action, when, who, with, what, run, seed, note

bpmn:task.name: Execute a step: stamp executed or reused

bpmn:textAnnotation.bpmn:text: One commit per checkpoint: its trailers restate the entry (Prov-Action, Prov-When, Prov-Run, Prov-Node), and its body keeps that checkpoint's step records.
No sidecar record file: the study and its repository hold the whole record.
